traits.name: Devil’s Sight
traits.text: Magical darkness doesn’t impede the devil’s darkvision.

traits.name: Keen Smell
traits.text:
The devil dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception)
checks that rely on smell.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
The devil has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Scent of Prey
traits.text:
The devil dog knows the exact location of any soul
whose true name it knows, as long as that soul resides in a vessel or body
within 1 mile. If the soul is beyond that distance, it knows the direction
the soul lies in. If the soul is on a different plane of existence, it knows the
plane that the soul resides on.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13
(2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a
DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Claws
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11
(2d6 + 4) slashing damage.
